description: The support tiers (ROUGHBOOK-FRAMEWORKS-PLAN.md, "Support tiers, for launch"): every recipe in the launch order, and how far it is proven. passing: the conformance suite passes on the systems named. unverified: the recipe is written and tested without a real run, for the reason given, so a repo on it is in the verified tier until it passes. Every stack without a recipe is the verified tier: the designer's agent builds the preview setup and roughbook doctor proves it on that repo. needs are the programs the recipe's commands and scaffold run, as doctor's step 0 looks for them, and hints say how to install each, as doctor does. node says whether the stack's own tools need Node.js, so the npm install is offered first. The web carries this file byte for byte as src/lib/support.json, for its FAQ, install page and setup guides.

recipes.name: Shopify themes
recipes.reason: Its live run needs the Shopify CLI signed in to a development store, and has not been run against one yet.

recipes.name: Flutter
recipes.reason: Not yet run against a real Flutter app: the recipe is tested without the Flutter SDK.

recipes.name: SwiftUI
recipes.reason: Not yet run on a Mac: the recipe is tested without Xcode.

recipes.name: Jetpack Compose
recipes.scaffold: an Android Studio-style Compose app, with a Gradle wrapper

hints.adb: adb comes with the Android SDK's platform tools (Android Studio installs them); add platform-tools to the PATH or set ANDROID_HOME.
hints.composer: Install Composer from getcomposer.org; Laravel Herd includes it.
hints.docker: Install Docker Desktop from docker.com and start it.
hints.flutter: Install Flutter from docs.flutter.dev and add its bin folder to the PATH.
hints.git: Install Git from git-scm.com, and open a new terminal.
hints.gradle: Install Gradle from gradle.org/install (or with SDKMAN or Homebrew), or use the gradlew script the project ships.
hints.java: Install a Java runtime, such as Temurin from adoptium.net.
hints.node: Install Node.js 22 or later from nodejs.org, and open a new terminal.
hints.php: Install PHP 8 from php.net (or Laravel Herd, which includes it), and open a new terminal.
hints.shopify: Install the Shopify CLI with npm install -g @shopify/cli.
hints.swift: Install Xcode from the App Store (macOS only): SwiftUI previews render on a Mac.
hints.xcrun: Install Xcode from the App Store (macOS only), then xcode-select --install.
